entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your painful stare unnerves your target, making it oblivious to its surroundings.

Prerequisite(s): Mesmerist level 5th, painful stare class feature.

Benefit(s): When you trigger your painful stare, the target must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your mesmerist level + your Charisma modifier) or take a –6 penalty on Disable Device and Perception checks and a –2 penalty on Reflex saves for the next minute. If the target has the trap finding or trap sense class ability and fails this save, the target also loses the benefit of that ability (or abilities) for 1 minute.
